markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (95%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set holds Normal only [F1], but the second model (MUSK) picks a different top class.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 95%, Benign 5%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Disagrees on top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 3, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Unreliable
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 2, 6, 7) · context · Above-typical score; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; no invasive-leaning signal · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20 spot check) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Image is simulated with JPEG degradation (severity 3); the MUSK second model already disagrees on top class.
- Calibration was checked on only 132 test images; ECE 0.05 (CI 0.03–0.18).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 11:** confirm normal lobules directly; spot check of this concept was 0/20.
2. **Regions 2, 6, 7:** confirm the lymphocytic infiltrate; spot check was only 8/20.
3. **Region 3:** top tile for invasion and pleomorphism concepts; confirm no invasive focus.
